arxiv-1910-02668.title: A central limit theorem for the number of isolated vertices in a preferential attachment random graph
arxiv-1910-02668.creator: Carina Betken
arxiv-1910-02668.description: Abstract We study the number of isolated vertices in a preferential attachment random graph introduced by Dereich and Mörters in 2009. In this graph model vertices are added over time and newly arriving vertices connect to older ones with probability proportional to a (sub-)linear function of the indegree of the older vertex at that time.

arxiv-2109-12217.title: Egyptian Fractions with Denominators from Sequences Closed Under Doubling
arxiv-2109-12217.creator: David Eppstein
arxiv-2109-12217.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by David Eppstein. Resolving a conjecture of Zhi-Wei Sun, we prove that every rational number can be represented as a sum of distinct unit fractions whose denominators are practical numbers. The same method applies to allowed denominators that are closed under multiplication by two and include a multiple of every positive integer, including the odious numbers, evil numbers, Hardy–Ramanujan numbers, Jordan–Pólya numbers, and fibbinary numbers.

arxiv-2111-06000.title: Primordial Big Bang Nucleosynthesis and Generalized Uncertainty Principle
arxiv-2111-06000.creator: Giuseppe Gaetano Luciano 1 , 2 {}^{\hskip 0.85358pt1,2}
arxiv-2111-06000.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Giuseppe Gaetano Luciano 1 , 2 {}^{\hskip 0.85358pt1,2}. The Generalized Uncertainty Principle (GUP) naturally emerges in several quantum gravity models, predicting the existence of a minimal length at Planck scale. Here, we consider the quadratic GUP as a semiclassical approach to thermodynamic gravity and constrain the deformation parameter by using observational bounds from Big Bang Nucleosynthesis and primordial abundances of the light elements H 4 ​ e , D , L 7 ​ i {}^{4}He,D,{}^{7}Li .

arxiv-2203-01638.title: Fabry-Perot microcavity spectra have a fine structure
arxiv-2203-01638.creator: M. P. van Exter 1, M. Wubs 2, E. Hissink 1, C. Koks 1
arxiv-2203-01638.description: Abstract Optical cavities can support many transverse and longitudinal modes. A paraxial scalar theory predicts that the resonance frequencies of these modes cluster in different orders. A non-paraxial vector theory predicts that the frequency degeneracy within these clusters is lifted, such that each order acquires a spectral fine structure, comparable to the fine structure observed in atomic spectra.

arxiv-2304-13208.title: Exploring the origins of perpendicular magnetic anisotropy in amorphous Tb-Co via changes in medium-range ordering
arxiv-2304-13208.creator: Ellis Kennedy, Emily Hollingworth, Alejandro Ceballos, Daisy O’Mahoney, Colin Ophus, Frances Hellman, M.C. Scott
arxiv-2304-13208.description: Abstract Amorphous thin films of Tb 17 Co 83 ( a -Tb-Co) grown by magnetron co-sputtering exhibit changes in magnetic anisotropy with varying growth and annealing temperatures. The magnetic anisotropy constant increases with increasing growth temperature, which is reduced or vanishes upon annealing at temperatures above the growth temperature.

arxiv-2402-15193.creator: X. Wang 1,2, I. Krois 3, N. Ha-Van 1, M. S. Mirmoosa 1, P. Jayathurathnage 1,4, S. Hrabar 3, S. A. Tretyakov 1

arxiv-2508-08578.title: DeePConverter: A Data-Driven Optimal Control Architecture for Grid-Connected Power Converters
arxiv-2508-08578.creator: Ruohan Leng, Linbin Huang, Member, IEEE, Huanhai Xin, Senior Member, IEEE, Ping Ju, Senior Member, IEEE, Xiongfei Wang, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2508-08578.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ruohan Leng, Linbin Huang, Member, IEEE, Huanhai Xin, Senior Member, IEEE, Ping Ju, Senior Member, IEEE, Xiongfei Wang, Fellow, IEEE. Grid-connected power converters are ubiquitous in modern power systems, acting as grid interfaces of renewable energy sources, energy storage systems, electric vehicles, high-voltage DC systems, etc. Conventionally, power converters use multiple PID regulators to achieve different control objectives such as grid synchronization and voltage/power regulations, where the PID parameters are usually tuned based on a presumed (and often overly-simplified) power grid model.

arxiv-2512-10071.creator: Team Comet
arxiv-2512-10071.description: Abstract The 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge is designed to rigorously track progress toward solving long-horizon tasks by physical agents in simulated environments. pmc-11499312.creator: Anna H Dlott, Sara A Spencer, Anthony J Di Pasqua
pmc-11499312.description: This review examines the pharmacology, efficacy and safety, dosage and administration, and place in therapy of the combination of 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) and calcipotriol for the treatment of actinic keratosis. Currently, 5% 5-FU topical cream is approved for actinic keratosis treatment, while calcipotriol is indicated for plaque psoriasis in adults.

pmc-11500090.title: Eliminating gender bias in biomedical research requires fair inclusion of pregnant women and gender diverse people
pmc-11500090.creator: Mridula Shankar, A Metin Gülmezoglu, Joshua P Vogel, Shivaprasad S Goudar, Annie McDougall, Manjunath S Somannavar, Sara Rushwan, Yeshita V Pujar, Umesh Charantimath, Anne Ammerdorffer, Meghan A Bohren
pmc-11500090.description: Systematic under-representation of pregnant women and gender diverse pregnant people in clinical research has prevented them from benefitting fairly from biomedical advances. The resulting lack of pharmacological safety and efficacy data leads to medicine discontinuation, sub-optimal dosing, and reliance on repurposed therapies. We identify four roadblocks to fair inclusion.

pmc-11736000.creator: Radwa Asar, Poonam Dhindwal, Antonio Ruzzini
pmc-11736000.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The bile salt hydrolases (BSHs) are significant constituents of animal microbiomes. These bacterial enzymes belong to the N-terminal nucleophile superfamily and are best known to catalyze the deconjugation of glycine or taurine from bile salts to release bile acid substrates for transformation and or metabolism in the gastrointestinal tract.

uslaw-usc-t12-s247.title: 12 U.S.C. § 247 — Reports to Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s247.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s247.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 3 (Federal Reserve System); Subchapter II (Board Of Governors Of The Federal Reserve System). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System shall annually make a full report of its operations to the Speaker of the House of Representatives, who shall cause the same to be printed.

uslaw-usc-t20-s6082.title: 20 U.S.C. § 6082 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t20-s6082.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t20-s6082.description: United States Code, Title 20 (Education); Chapter 68 (National Education Reform); Subchapter X (Miscellaneous); Part B (Environmental Tobacco Smoke). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. As used in this part: (1) Children The term “children” means individuals who have not attained the age of 18. (2) Children’s services The term “children’s services” means the provision on a routine or regular basis of health.

uslaw-usc-t7-s1608.title: 7 U.S.C. § 1608 — Separability
uslaw-usc-t7-s1608.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s1608.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 37 (Seeds); Subchapter IV (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. If any provision of this chapter, or the application thereof to any person or circumstance, is held invalid, the remainder of the chapter, and the application of such provisions to other persons or circumstances, shall not be affected thereby.
